title: cache-mode read on actions/cache: 'cache write denied' warning on read-only jobs until actions/cache 6.2.0 is pinned
answers: Why do read-only test jobs log a 'cache write denied' warning every run?
Is the cache write denied warning in CI a failure I need to fix?
When does the cache-hf read path stop logging the write-denied warning?
What changes when actions/cache is bumped past v6.1.0?
body:
Path: .github/actions/cache-hf/action.yml runs the pinned actions/cache (v6.1.0, @actions/cache 6.1.0) for read-only consumers such as protobuf-cross-test.yml and test-requirements.yml, which run with `cache-mode: read`.
Rule: `cache-mode: read` denies saves at the token level, but actions/cache 6.1.0 does not read ACTIONS_CACHE_MODE, so each read job logs one `cache write denied` warning per run. The warning is expected and harmless. The fix is the actions/cache 6.2.0 bump, which skips the save instead; do not reintroduce a restore-only branch to silence it.
Symptom: Read-only test jobs printed a `cache write denied` warning on every run after the default-deny cache-mode change.
Constraints: Applies only until the pinned actions/cache is at 6.2.0 or later; after the bump, no change in the workflows is needed. Per the PR description, 6.2.0 was on main but not yet tagged, so check the pinned version before assuming the warning is gone.
applies: CI jobs with cache-mode read that call the cache-hf composite, while actions/cache is pinned below 6.2.0.
says: Automated test logs display a cache write denied warning on every single run.
Investigate whether the cache write denied alert in test runs indicates a pipeline failure.
Read-only continuous integration jobs are cluttering build output with harmless cache warnings.
Suppress the cache permission warnings appearing across automated test workflow runs.
search: CI jobs running .github/actions/cache-hf/action.yml with cache-mode: read log an expected, harmless 'cache write denied' warning until actions/cache is upgraded to version 6.2.0 or later. Under actions/cache v6.1.0, ACTIONS_CACHE_MODE is ignored and write denial occurs at the token level. Workflows such as protobuf-cross-test.yml and test-requirements.yml should not reintroduce restore-only branches to suppress this warning, as version 6.2.0 natively skips the save attempt.
